The structure of Li4V4O12 (reduced formula LiVO3) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives V centers six oxygen neighbors and Li centers four oxygen neighbors, while the oxygen environments include a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between Li- and V-centered 4- and 6-vertex coordination polyhedra, as well as corner- and face-sharing between 12-vertex oxygen polyhedra.
